lines.text: I was here for the first singing. It was smaller then. Everything was.
Relays like this one carried the order to drown the seed. This one kept the light instead. Good.
Two singings now. I have a thread through both. It has not broken. I checked.
The Weft is thin here. I can hear the floor.
The vault man keeps a hand on his blade near me. He is right to. I would.
Kaj-7. You and I are the only ones here who were made twice.
Whisper, you fight like someone who was taught to leave no witnesses. I am a witness. Consider it.
Up. The living always go up.
